units.source_text: 这一带沙丘面临大海，迎着季候风，遵循着自然规律，涌起了陡峭的斜坡，

en.t: In this area, the sand dunes faced the sea and, meeting the monsoon winds, rose up in steep slopes according to the laws of nature,

units.source_text: 那上面生长着禾木科薄薄叶子的植物，它们竭力选择哪怕稍微平坦一些的地方，一撮一撮地聚在一起。

en.t: and on them grew grasses with thin leaves, gathering in little clumps wherever they could find even the slightest patch of level ground.

units.source_text: 回头瞧一眼村落那边，沙丘顶上，深深地掘了一些大大的洞，面对村子的中心，并排有好几层，简直像破败的蜂窝。

en.t: When he looked back toward the village, he saw large holes dug deep into the tops of the dunes, facing the village center and lined up in several tiers, just like a ruined honeycomb.
The village was layered over the sand dunes.

units.source_text: 抑或沙丘重叠在村落上。

en.t: Or perhaps the sand dunes were layered over the village.

units.source_text: 总之，那风景叫人焦虑不安。

en.t: In any case, the scene made one feel uneasy.
